name: knowing
description: knowing, a learning and research skill set: make sense of a body of material such as notes, papers, or a wiki (understand), a sourced deep investigation (investigate), what's new on a topic from arXiv, Hacker News, GitHub, and OpenAlex (latest), interactive lessons with spaced practice for the user (learn), teaching a learner, a child from their schoolwork or someone new to programming (tutor), and explaining how something works as an interactive isometric drawing of a machine or an idea built as a real object (figure; needs Chrome for its checks). Independent of flowstate. Ideas adapted from mvanhorn/last30days-skill and Egonex-AI/Understand-Anything (MIT); figure is wheresryan22/anatomy (MIT), copied with its licence.
